name: search_biomedical_articles
description: Use this tool to search for biomedical articles related to a specific disease name. It is suitable when you need to find research papers, reviews, or clinical studies associated with a particular disease. Do not use this tool for general medical inquiries or non-biomedical topics. For broader medical searches, consider using a general search engine or medical database that covers a wider range of topics.

parameters.name: disease_name
parameters.description: The name of the disease for which to search biomedical articles. Must be a valid disease name as recognized in medical literature.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of articles to return. Must be a positive integer. Default is 10.

parameters.name: include_reviews
parameters.description: Indicates whether to include review articles in the search results. Default is true.

articles.description: An array of articles found in the search.

authors.description: A list of authors of the article.

journal.description: The journal in which the article was published.

publication_date.description: The publication date of the article in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

abstract.description: A brief summary of the article.

doi.description: The Digital Object Identifier of the article.

return_schema.description: A list of biomedical articles related to the specified disease name.
